_doc: Procedural map templates (src/world/generation). A template is a graph of zones joined by connections. Zones are laid out by a warped, weighted Voronoi partition around their anchors (fractions of the map size); zone borders become mountain walls and each connection carves a pass of `width` tiles through the wall, optionally held by a gate guard. Zone content comes from a profile in `profiles`; zones that share a `group` get identical rolled content (same mines, piles, guard strengths) so starts stay fair. `mirror` names the zone this one is the 180-degree rotation of (only with symmetry rotate180; `self` for the centre). Distance bands are movement points from the zone anchor (town or centre). Guard values are gold-equivalent army values (see guard_levels). Towns, mines and encounters use the map object schema of docs/DESIGN.md section 4: neutral towns get a `garrison` of the profile's level, guarded mines carry their own `guard`. Encounters are drawn from `encounter_risk` tiers (low in home zones, high in contested ones) and never placed on roads or passes.

armor_drops._doc: Armor pieces (artifacts in drop_slots of artifacts.json). per_player: one identical piece in every start zone, behind the same guard at the same distance. extras: min-max more pieces in the open zones (weighted by profile), rarity weighted; each rarity sets its guard level.

hoard_rules._doc: Guarded hoards, the density fill (MapGenerator._place_hoards). Each profile's `hoards` gives one hoard per `per_tiles` open zone tiles (clamped to min/max); each pick sets the guard level, distance band and weight. Guards vary by +-guard_spread around their level. With artifact_chance a hoard holds a droppable armour piece of the rarity artifact_rarity gives the level, otherwise resources worth value_ratio of the rolled guard (at least min_value gold-equivalent), the kind drawn by resource_weights (rare = a random rare resource). Mirrored zones get identical hoards.

scatter_rules._doc: Scattered piles (MapGenerator._place_scatter): unguarded resource piles, one per `per_tiles` open zone tiles of a profile's `scatter` (clamped to min/max), so large zones are not emptier than small ones. The kind is drawn by resource_weights (rare = a random rare resource, amounts from pile_amounts) and the distance band by band_weights. Mirrored zones get identical piles.

random_maps._doc: Random maps for the new-game screen (src/world/generation/random_map_template.gd, layout_families.gd). A random map is the template random_<size>_<players>p_<monsters>_<treasure>[_<family>]; without a family the seed picks one of the families that fit the player count, by weight. sizes: player_tiles is the map area per player (the square side follows, clamped to min_side/max_side); rings are the optional zone rings of the ring and archipelago families (wild backwaters, approach zones between start and heart, outer zones at the edge; the outer ring needs the wild ring). families: the zone graphs (see LayoutFamilies), with player range, weight, loop_chance (extra loop passes) and walls {water: chance a border is a lake instead of a ridge, thick: [lo, hi] extra wall tiles on each side}. Every map turns and mirrors its family into one of 8 orientations and jitters its anchors by anchor_jitter. pass_width: width range of unguarded passes (guarded passes are one tile, the guard is the chokepoint). neutral_towns: chances of 0, 1 or 2 neutral towns (scaled with the players, at most one per player), placed in the most contested zones, with this garrison unless the zone profile names one. optional_profiles: weights of the profiles rolled for optional zones (treasure valleys, mine lands, ruins, backwaters). monsters scale every neutral army (guard_scale), treasure scales hoards and scattered piles (treasure_scale). factions: the generator factions the player slots cycle through before the new-game setup sets the real ones; colors: one per player slot. guard_pockets: how guarded treasure is laid out, open (prize in the open, guard on a neighbouring tile; the guard rule keeps it out of reach) or sealed (walled pocket, the default of the named templates). curated: named seeds the new-game menu offers (GameSetup.curated_entries), {id, name, template, seed, text}: template is a random-map name that names its layout family; a mission adds recipe (a current scenario recipe, at most 4 players, no template for labyrinth). A curated entry always plays gen:<template>:<seed> (or scenario:<recipe>[:<template>]:<seed>); the seed box then only seeds the game.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Starts around a contested heartland, with flank zones between neighbours.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: Every realm reaches the heart down its own spoke; side valleys hang off each start.

archipelago.name: Archipelago
archipelago.description: Realms on islands split by dark lakes, joined by land bridges.

diagonal.name: Diagonal
diagonal.description: Corner to corner: the high road crosses the heart, long loops run round the far corners.

lanes.name: Lanes
lanes.description: Three roads between two edges, with contested valleys on the outer lanes.

tree.name: Branching
tree.description: Branching valleys and deep dead ends; the realms meet only in the heart.

curated.name: The Ember Crown
curated.text: Two realms circle a smouldering heartland; every road bends toward the middle.

curated.name: Four Hearths Burning
curated.text: Four realms round a contested heart, with flank country between each pair of neighbours.

curated.name: The Widow's Circle
curated.text: Three realms on a vast, rich ring: long marches and deep wilds before anyone meets.

curated.name: Sixfold Ash
curated.text: Six banners crowd one ring of ash; alliances form fast and break faster.

curated.name: Spokes of the Iron Wheel
curated.text: Each realm rides its own spoke to the hub; side valleys reward the patient.

curated.name: The Hollow Throne
curated.text: Four spokes lead to an empty seat of power, guarded by hard-bitten monsters.

curated.name: Where Five Roads Bleed
curated.text: Five rich realms, one crowded heart. Whoever holds the hub holds every road.

curated.name: Isles of the Black Mere
curated.text: Two island realms joined by narrow land bridges across dark water.

curated.name: Tarnwater Holds
curated.text: Four holds on wealthy isles; every bridge is a chokepoint worth a battle.

curated.name: Six Drowned Kings
curated.text: Six island crowns around a sunken heart, linked only by bridges of stone.

curated.name: The Gallows Road
curated.text: Corner to corner along one high road, with long loops round the far corners.

curated.name: Corners of Ruin
curated.text: A wide diagonal march through rich, deadly country.

curated.name: A Thin Road through Ash
curated.text: A short, lean duel: little treasure, weak guards, an early clash.

curated.name: Three Furrows
curated.text: Three roads between two edges; the outer lanes hide contested valleys.

curated.name: The Gilded Ditches
curated.text: Three long lanes lined with hoards. Pick one to hold and one to raid.

curated.name: Knifepoint Lanes
curated.text: Close lanes, hard guards: every pass costs blood.

curated.name: Rootdeep
curated.text: Branching valleys and deep dead ends; the realms meet only in the heart.

curated.name: The Forked Vale
curated.text: A broad tree of valleys with long trunks to the meeting ground.

curated.name: Under the Elder Boughs
curated.text: A huge branching wild of rich dead ends and strong guardians.

curated.name: The Ashwall Vigil
curated.text: A stronghold at the end of its spoke, with the hill folk one valley away.

curated.name: The Drowned Watch
curated.text: Hold an island keep while the host crosses the bridges.

curated.name: The Brazier Line
curated.text: Three keeps strung along a ring; the host can strike any of them.

curated.name: Keeps of the Salt Marsh
curated.text: Three keeps on the spokes of a hard country.

curated.name: The Cinder Tide
curated.text: Wave after wave across open ring country. How long can the walls stand?

curated.name: Vigil of the Last Lantern
curated.text: A rich, sprawling hub to fortify against a host that never ends.

curated.name: A Banner in the Reeds
curated.text: A lone captain among the reed villages, one rival across the lanes.

curated.name: The Wanderer's Crown
curated.text: No hall, no crown: win the villages of your spoke before two rivals ride in.

curated.name: Beneath the Stone Heart
curated.text: A tight maze of guarded turns around a buried prize.

curated.name: The Gloam Warren
curated.text: Long corridors and false ends; the deadline is the real enemy.

sites._doc: Rare map buildings (data/sites.json). per_player: one identical site of these kinds in every start zone, at the same distance. extras: min-max more picks in the open zones; each pick goes into every zone of a zone group chosen by profile weight (so mirrored zones get the same site, guard and creature). A site is never used twice on one map.

valley._doc: Optional treasure valley of the random-map families: rich, well guarded, out of the way.

mineland._doc: Optional mine land of the random-map families: a cluster of guarded mines worth a second week of expansion.

ruins._doc: Optional ruins of the random-map families: rare sites and encounters to explore (site_picks sites of their own).
